title: BalancePet notification state v1
description: Sanitized live state the host publishes for feature extensions holding the notifications.read capability. It is a snapshot, not a log: the host rewrites the whole file, so consumers should read it whole and must tolerate a partially written read. Only counters, names and statuses appear here; prompts, replies, credentials and plaintext tokens never do.

updated_at.description: When the host last rewrote this snapshot.

core_version.description: Version of the host that produced the snapshot.

task_known.description: Whether the host has any observation about AI task activity at all. False means the task fields carry no information, which is different from 'no task is running'.

task_active.description: True while at least one AI task is running.

task_provider.description: Client driving the active task, or the last one to finish. Free text supplied by the client.

login_known.description: Whether the host has a live login observation. Always false as of host 1.3.0: the CC Switch integration that supplied it was removed to be rebuilt as a plugin, and consumers should fall back to their own recorded login events rather than treat false as 'logged out'.

login_mode.description: Human-readable login mode. Empty while login_known is false.

login_detail.description: Account label behind login_mode. Empty while login_known is false.

balance.description: Latest balance of the account the user selected. Omitted when that account has no reading yet; an absent value means unknown, not zero.

currency.description: Currency code for balance, upper case.

spent.description: Amount the most recently finished task consumed, when the host could attribute one. Omitted otherwise.

spent_currency.description: Currency code for spent, upper case.
